title: YouTube to MP3 & Audio Converter input
description: Paste one or more YouTube video URLs (or 11-character video IDs) and choose the output audio format and quality. Each successfully converted video is charged as one 'audio-conversion' event.

urls.title: YouTube video URLs
urls.description: YouTube video URLs (watch, youtu.be, shorts, embed, music.youtube.com) or plain video IDs. Maximum source length is 3 hours.

format.title: Output format
format.description: Audio container/codec of the output file.

quality.title: Audio quality
quality.description: 'standard' is a good default, 'best' keeps the highest available source quality, numeric values are target bitrates in kbps (lossy formats only).

startTime.title: Clip start (seconds)
startTime.description: Optional. Start of the clip in seconds from the beginning of the video. Applied to every URL.

endTime.title: Clip end (seconds)
endTime.description: Optional. End of the clip in seconds. Must be greater than the start. Applied to every URL.

storeFile.title: Save audio file to key-value store
storeFile.description: Download each converted file and save it into this run's key-value store, so it stays available after the short-lived download link expires (subject to your Apify storage retention).

maxConcurrency.title: Max parallel conversions
maxConcurrency.description: How many videos are converted at the same time.
